title: Aerodynamic Comparison of Shuttlecocks
subtitle: Experimental investigation in National Wind Tunnel Facility (NWTF), IIT Kanpur
description: Undergraduate thesis research under Prof. Sanjay Mittal comparing the aerodynamic characteristics, drag profiles, and vortex dynamics of synthetic vs natural shuttlecocks across varying rotation speeds and Reynolds numbers.
facility: National Wind Tunnel Facility (NWTF), IIT Kanpur
imageCaption: Experimental setup inside the test section at National Wind Tunnel Facility (NWTF), IIT Kanpur
highlights: Compared aerodynamic drag, rotation rate, and trajectory behavior across Yonex Mavis 350 (nylon), Mavis 2000 (advanced nylon), and Aerosensa 50 (feather).
Conducted closed-circuit wind tunnel testing in the National Wind Tunnel Facility (NWTF) at IIT Kanpur.
